notes: The market cap under $2B criterion is drafted as it reads; the server turns the 'except' into 'none of'.
Near-high tolerance of 0.02 (2 points of distance) was my choice, since the guide's tolerance is for a 10% threshold.
A null market cap (ETFs, many ADRs, stale share counts) is not under $2B, so those names are not excluded by that part.

suggestions.why: A report in the next ten sessions lifts IV rank by itself; the high rank may be the earnings premium.
A pending takeover pins the price at its high and collapses IV, so a name that will not move should be kept out.

parts.reading: Close within 5% of the 52-week high (-0.05 or higher); 0.02 further still shown
Market cap under 2000000000, excluded from the picks
IV rank above 0.8; 0.1 less is still shown
